body:
Track 2 follow-up to `ambient-ips`: compares biased, IPS and full-information fits on the same logged history. Result: the bias is large in this stylised world (full-information fit reaches the oracle; biased fit loses 1.3–2.1 utility/h or fails); IPS recovers part only at ε=0.02 with an informed prior. Caveat noted in README: no label-matched control. 4 tests, `python site/build.py` ok.
